policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule places Bhutan in its Prior to Arrival visa category.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bhutanese passport holder visiting Grenada; the schedule defines 'Prior To Arrival' as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
Admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control and the requirements of the competent mission or consulate.

policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Bhutan in its no-visa-required cohort for short visitor stays.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bhutanese passport holder travelling to Panama as a short visitor; the Embassy states a maximum stay of three months for this cohort.
Passport validity, return travel, means of support, carrier checks and final admission remain separately required.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, special documents and other non-visitor purposes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly marks Bhutan ineligible for an arrival visa and directs travellers to obtain a visa from an embassy before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bhutanese passport holder travelling to Jordan as a short visitor.
The official table directs Bhutanese visitors to contact the nearest Jordanian Embassy and obtain the visa before arrival.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Jordan Tourism Board visa requirements
steps: Contact the competent Jordanian Embassy before travel.
Obtain the visitor visa before departure and carry the required supporting documents.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says visa on arrival, while Jordan's live official nationality table marks Bhutan not applicable for arrival issuance and requires an embassy visa before arrival.
